blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The co-accused in the plunder case of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez surrendered “peacefully” in Forbes Park in Makati City, the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) said on Friday. Felicito Cristobal Guevarra’s “surrender” to the NBI’s public corruption division on Thursday morning was “peaceful and orderly,” according to the bureau. READ: Romualdez co-accused
